description: Rebuild the HOME page (src/app/page.tsx) to match the prototype: hero (two-column, video frame with parallax), animated metric bar, Our Work 2x2 grid, Services scroll sticky-stage, tech marquee, dark Why Choose Us band, founder quote, and How We Work band. Depends on FEAT-001 (fonts, tokens, motion module, chrome). Replaces the current hero/ScrollStory/EvidenceStory home layout for the redesign. All new section CSS goes in globals.css. Verify with check:copy and by reading for dead asset srcs.
steps:
HERO section: grid grid-template-columns minmax(0,0.85fr) minmax(0,1.15fr) gap clamp(24px,4vw,60px) align-items center, width min(1120px,calc(100% - 48px)) margin 0 auto, min-height min(78vh,640px). LEFT [data-reveal]: eyebrow

with a 7px pink dot span animating pulse-dot 2.2s infinite + text 'Expertise / Innovation / Partnership' (use forward slashes or middots, NOT an em dash; 12px w700 uppercase letter-spacing .13em accent color). H1 in Space Grotesk 600 clamp(2.2rem,3.4vw,3.5rem)/1.05 = 'Your strategic partner in building ' + (font-style normal, color accent-hover) 'scalable AI products.'. Intro

max-width 34rem, muted, 17px/1.65 = 'We combine AI, software engineering, and automation with deep industry expertise to build scalable, sustainable solutions, working alongside you as a trusted, long-term partner.' CTA row: 'Let\'s connect' solid pink pill link to /contact-us + 'Explore services' pink text link to /services (each with aria-hidden arrow glyph). RIGHT: a [data-hero-frame] div position relative width100% aspect-ratio 16/9 border-radius 22px overflow hidden, 4px solid border color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-page) 78%, transparent), gradient background linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.92 0.05 305), oklch(0.94 0.04 220) 58%, oklch(0.94 0.052 145)), box-shadow 0 22px 58px oklch(0.28 0.03 285/0.14). Inside: a

METRIC BAR: width min(1120px,calc(100% - 48px)) margin 0 auto with bottom spacing ~56px; grid 4 cols; border 1px var(--color-line) radius 8px background color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-page) 78%, transparent). Map site.stats (from src/content/site.ts) to four [data-metric] cells with data-target={value} data-prefix={prefix||''} data-suffix={suffix}: (45,'+','Projects Delivered'),(10,'$','M+','Client Value Generated'),(35,'+','Expert Team Members'),(6,'+','Years of Excellence'). Each cell: <strong> Space Grotesk 600 clamp(1.7rem,2.3vw,2.4rem)/1 initial text prefix+'0'+ (suffix omitted until count-up finishes, matching prototype which starts '0'/'$0') and <span> 12.5px muted label. The motion module animates the count-up; ensure the no-JS/reduced-motion final value (prefix+value+suffix) is present as real text so the bar is meaningful without JS (render final value in the strong and let JS reset-then-animate, OR render final value and only animate when data-js+motion allowed).

OUR WORK section: eyebrow 'Our work', h2 (Space Grotesk) 'Complex problems, useful products.', sub 'Selected platforms designed around real operations, customers, and growth.' Grid 2x2 of
cards: border 1px var(--color-line) radius 18 bg #fff box-shadow 0 14px 45px oklch(0.25 0.02 285/0.06). Each card: media div aspect-ratio 16/10 with a per-card pastel gradient background (car -> oklch(0.92 0.05 305); investigation -> oklch(0.94 0.04 220); luxury -> oklch(0.94 0.052 145); sukoon -> oklch(0.96 0.06 88)) used as a CSS-gradient PLACEHOLDER (no to missing project-*.webp; if a foreground is wanted use an inline decorative SVG or a data-parallax-img-styled gradient block, aria-hidden); body padding 20px 22px with h3 (1.15rem Space Grotesk) + p (14.5px muted). Titles/links map to real projects (reuse src/content/projects.ts slugs where a matching engagement exists): 'AI-Based Software for Luxury Car Dealers' (luxury-car-dealer-software), 'Investigative Case Management Software' (investigative-case-management), 'AI-Powered Luxury eCommerce Platform' (luxury-ecommerce-platform), 'Senior Engagement & Support Platform' (senior-engagement-platform). Cards link to /projects/. Then a centered 'View all work' pink pill link to /projects.

SERVICES scroll sticky-stage (#services-stage): eyebrow 'Services', h2 'Apps, websites, AI and more.' Grid 2 cols minmax(0,0.9fr)/minmax(0,1.1fr). LEFT position:sticky top:14vh height min(64vh,560px) rounded 20 gradient(135deg, oklch(0.92 0.05 305), oklch(0.94 0.04 220)) containing four stacked decorative panels marked [data-service-img="0".."3"] (inset ~7% w/h 86%, only index 0 visible/opacity1 initially). Since service-ai/web/commerce/cloud art is MISSING, implement each [data-service-img] as a distinct inline-SVG or gradient/label placeholder (aria-hidden), NOT an to a missing file. RIGHT: four
(index 0..3) each min-height min(64vh,540px) flex column center opacity .32: '01 AI & ML - Predictive analytics, computer vision, and generative AI that turn data into decisions.'; '02 Web / Mobile App / SaaS - Enterprise SaaS, web, and mobile apps built to perform and grow.'; '03 E-commerce - Marketplaces and subscription commerce that improve conversions.'; '04 Cloud - Migration, DevOps automation, and disaster recovery for resilient systems.' (use a hyphen or colon, NOT an em dash). The motion module (FEAT-001) drives the focus/crossfade: exactly one image shows at a time, focused row animates .32->1. No-JS/reduced-motion: all rows opacity 1, first image (or all) shown. Then a centered 'Explore services' pink pill link to /services.

TECH MARQUEE: eyebrow 'Platforms & partners', h2 'Tools and technologies.' A full-width overflow-hidden strip, mask-image linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 6% 94%,transparent); inner flex gap 48 width max-content animation marquee-scroll 26s linear infinite (gated by html[data-js]; paused/none under reduced-motion). TWO identical tracks (2nd aria-hidden) each listing 8 items. Since tech-*.png logos are MISSING, render each item as a styled monochrome text wordmark (span, muted, 14px w600) with the tech name, NOT an to a missing file. Use src/content/services.ts techStackFlat where the names align (Langchain, Python, Tensorflow, OpenAI, Hugging Face, Pinecone, Apache Kafka, Elastic Search) - reuse that array. The marquee is decorative; expose the tech names once for AT (visually-hidden list) and mark the animated tracks aria-hidden.

WHY CHOOSE US dark band: background var(--color-ink) color var(--color-page) padding-block 64. eyebrow (accent-light color) 'Why choose us', h2 'Built for lasting impact.' 4-col grid of <article data-reveal>: '01 Innovation at Our Core - We continuously explore emerging technologies to keep clients ahead.'; '02 Client Success Obsession - Your outcomes guide every decision, first idea through long-term growth.'; '03 Technology for Good - Thoughtful technology should simplify work and create sustainable value.'; '04 Continuous Learning - We invest in learning so every solution benefits from current thinking.' (labels muted; hyphens NOT em dashes).

FOUNDER quote: grid minmax(160px,220px)/1fr gap 28 center. Image = next/image /krupal-chaudhary.jpg (the existing portrait; the prototype's founder.webp is substituted by this) radius 16 aspect 1 object-fit cover, alt describing Krupal. blockquote p Space Grotesk 500 clamp(1.1rem,1.6vw,1.4rem)/1.55 = 'Through the strategic use of your vision and data, we design AI solutions that make your brand stand out and drive revenue growth, leading execution with focus and accountability.' footer strong 'Krupal Chaudhary' / span 'Founder & CEO'. (You may source name/title from site.founder.)

HOW WE WORK band: background color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.92 0.05 305) 42%, var(--color-page)) padding 64. eyebrow 'How we work', h2 'Clear from idea to scale.' 4-col: '01 Discover & Define - Focused discovery, research, and clear success metrics.'; '02 Design & Prototype - User-focused designs and interactive prototypes before development.'; '03 Build & Integrate - Scalable, secure, high-performance products with continuous feedback.'; '04 Launch & Scale - Confident launches and support for long-term optimization.' (hyphens NOT em dashes).

Remove/replace the old home sections (ScrollStory, EvidenceStory, home-expertise, home-studio, old hero/statbar) as needed so the page renders the prototype layout. You may leave the ScrollStory/EvidenceStory component files in the repo unused, but page.tsx must not import dead markup that references removed CSS. Add all new .home-* section CSS to globals.css with a responsive collapse <=820px (single column, stacked grids, 2x2 -> 1 col, metric bar 4->2 cols).

Update src/content/editorial.ts homeCopy (or add fields) so the exact prototype hero intro and section subs are sourced from content rather than hardcoded where practical; keep copy check:copy-clean (the existing `--` in homeCopy.intro is a double hyphen and is allowed, but if you rewrite it to the prototype intro use commas as specified).
acceptance_criteria: src/app/page.tsx renders, in order: hero (two-column + [data-hero-frame] video reusing /hero-transform.mp4), metric bar (4 [data-metric] cells from site.stats), Our Work 2x2 grid linking to real project slugs, Services sticky-stage (#services-stage with [data-service-row] 0..3 and [data-service-img] 0..3), tech marquee (two tracks, text wordmarks), dark Why Choose Us, founder quote (using /krupal-chaudhary.jpg), How We Work band.
No /
Headings/metric values/founder quote use Space Grotesk; body/UI uses DM Sans.
Metric bar shows the correct final values (45+, $10M+, 35+, 6+) as real text without JS, and count-up animates with JS when motion is allowed.
Services sticky-stage markup matches the motion module contract; with JS off or reduced-motion, all rows are legible and at least one service image placeholder is visible.
Layout collapses to a single column at <=820px; metric bar becomes 2 columns.
verification: Read src/app/page.tsx end-to-end; confirm every Image/video src exists in public/ (demaze-logo.png, hero-transform.mp4, krupal-chaudhary.jpg) or is a CSS/inline-SVG placeholder.
grep -R 'robot-studio\|project-.*\.webp\|service-.*\.webp\|tech-.*\.png\|founder\.webp' src/ returns no src usages.
Confirm [data-service-row] and [data-service-img] indices 0..3 exist and [data-metric]/[data-hero-frame]/[data-reveal] hooks match FEAT-001's motion module.
If deps install: unset NODE_OPTIONS && npm run build && npm run lint
findings: Rewrote src/app/page.tsx to the prototype home layout (hero two-column with [data-hero-frame] video reusing /hero-transform.mp4; animated metric bar of 4 [data-metric] cells from site.stats; Our Work 2x2 grid linking to /projects/; #services-stage with [data-service-row] and [data-service-img] 0..3; tech marquee with two aria-hidden tracks of text wordmarks from services.techStackFlat; dark Why Choose Us band; founder quote using /krupal-chaudhary.jpg via next Image; How We Work band). All exact prototype copy sourced from new exports in src/content/editorial.ts (homeHero, homeSections, homeWorkCards, homeServiceRows, homeWhyChooseUs, homeHowWeWork) - homeCopy left intact for other pages. Added all new .home-* section CSS to globals.css within a FEAT-002 block placed before legacy CSS, with a <=820px responsive collapse (single column, metric bar 4->2 cols). No /
